title: The Johnson-vs-capacity gap is an EXTREME-VALUE gap: in-tree code supplies BOTH endpoints [sqrt(n) proven, sqrt(n log m) conditional on one MGF]
reduced_to: Worst Gauss period B = max_{c} ||eta_c|| over the m=(p-1)/n cosets bracketed in [Theta(sqrt n), C*sqrt(2 sigma^2 log m)]: the LOWER endpoint Theta(sqrt n) is PROVEN axiom-clean in-tree (exists_period_sq_ge); the open core is the UPPER endpoint, i.e. the per-period sub-Gaussian MGF with sigma^2=O(n). That MGF input is NOT strictly weaker than the all-moments wall: by the standard equivalence sub-Gaussian MGF(sigma^2) <=> mu_{2r} <= (2r-1)!! sigma^{2r} for all r, it IS the generating function of GaussianEnergyBound E_r(mu_n) <= (2r-1)!! n^r, the same Lam-Leung char-p / BGK wall named in GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean.
wall: W-BGK (the upper-endpoint MGF input is the generating-function repackaging of the all-even-moments GaussianEnergyBound = the Lam-Leung char-p transfer wall; the lower endpoint and the extreme-value framing are genuine and proven, but the open core is unchanged).
evidence: Probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/: (1) probe_C006_extreme_value_bracket.py + probe_C006_crux_widerange.py: prize-regime thin subgroups n in {8,16,32,64}, primes p up to ~200000 with beta=log_n(p) up to ~5.9 (n<<sqrt q), m up to ~25000. (A) LOWER ENDPOINT: exists_period_sq_ge floor=(qE-n^4)/(qn-n^2) is EXACT-rational Theta(n); sqrt(floor)/sqrt(n) in [1.1,2.0] -> worst period genuinely Theta(sqrt n), NOT already sqrt(n log m). exists_period_sq_ge proof is a clean 4th-moment<=max*2nd-moment Cauchy-Schwarz pigeonhole, no sorry/axiom (file asserts propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound). (B) UPPER ENDPOINT valid: B/sqrt(2 n log m) in [0.6,1.0] across the full range; smallest sigma^2 fitting the Chernoff ceiling sqrt(2 sigma^2 log m)>=B has sigma^2/n bounded in [0.6,1.1]; chernoff_max_re_le is the axiom-clean maximal inequality. (C) CRUX: at the CORRECT optimal lambda*=sqrt(2 log m / n) (which GROWS with log m), the worst-direction MGF sigma2_eff/n stays bounded in [0.68,0.99] with slope ~0 vs log m (slopes -0.019..-0.002 over log m in [3.5,10.1]) and tracks the random-unimodular Salem-Zygmund control almost exactly -> the extreme-value/max-over-m framing is real and the empirical MGF IS O(n). (2) probe_C006_mgf_vs_moments.py: the worst-direction even moments satisfy mu_{2r}/((2r-1)!! n^r) <= 1 for ALL r tested (e.g. n=8: 0.9999->0.025 for 2r=2..16; n=16: 0.94->0.14; n=32: 0.97->0.40), confirming GaussianEnergyBound E_r<=(2r-1)!! n^r empirically AND showing the single MGF (sigma^2=n) encodes exactly that all-moments bound. GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean names GaussianEnergyBound as the open core with the same wall.
honest_note: Two-sided assessment. CORRECT in C006: (i) the lower endpoint Theta(sqrt n) is a real axiom-clean in-tree theorem and the worst period is genuinely Omega(sqrt n), not already sqrt(n log m); (ii) the bracket [sqrt n, sqrt(2 sigma^2 log m)] holds numerically with sigma^2=O(n); (iii) the Johnson->capacity gap really is the log m=log(p/n) extreme-value (max-over-m) enhancement, and the real Gauss sequence behaves like the idealized Salem-Zygmund random model. OVERCLAIMED in C006 and the decisive correction: the assertion that the open input is 'a SINGLE exponential moment, STRICTLY LESS than the BGK all-moments wall' is false. The sub-Gaussian MGF with sigma^2=O(n) is, by the standard MGF<->moments equivalence, the generating function of ALL even moments mu_{2r}<=(2r-1)!! sigma^{2r}; the maximal inequality consumes it at lambda* whose effective order r~log m, so it requires the high moments too. It is the same object as the in-tree GaussianEnergyBound (the Lam-Leung char-p / BGK wall), repackaged -- not a weaker single moment. So the open core is unchanged; this is a sharpened FRAMING (proven floor + extreme-value statement) but welds back to W-BGK. I did not build the cited oleans (no lock taken); axiom-cleanliness of exists_period_sq_ge is asserted by its source #print axioms and verified by reading the sorry-free proof, not re-run here. Probes use double-precision complex exp with exact mod-p integer arithmetic; m,p modest (computation infeasible at prize p~2^256), so the 'MGF=O(n) at prize scale' remains EMPIRICAL exactly as C006's own SalemZygmundChaining.lean honestly states (needs Katz/Rojas-Leon equidistribution, currently only qualitative).
